extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, authorised representatives, and agents completing EPO general authorisation (Form EPO 1004)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and mandatory requirements for completing and submitting the EPO General Authorisation form (EPO 1004) to authorise representatives/agents in proceedings under the European Patent Convention, including rules on signatures, addresses, sub-authorisations and termination. Targets how authorisors and authorisees must be named and identified and how registration/sub-authorisation numbers are handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form signature requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The form must bear the personal signature(s) of the authorisor(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mandatory: the physical/personal signature(s) are required on Form EPO 1004. (This requirement is explicitly stated on the form.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal person signatory eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: When the authorisation is signed on behalf of a legal person, only such persons as are entitled to sign by law and/or in accordance with the articles of association or equivalent of the legal person may do so.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a company/other legal entity signs the authorisation, ensure the signer has legal authority (e.g., directors, persons entitled by articles). Include any evidence if required by practice to show entitlement to sign.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declaration when authorisee is a practitioner
rubrics_metrics.description: If the authorisee is a practitioner, the authorisor must make a declaration in the general authorisation or in a covering letter that the authorisee is his practitioner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this form (or a covering letter) to state explicitly that the named authorisee is the authorisor's professional representative/practitioner, as recommended under Article 134(8).

rubrics_metrics.name: Addresses: full administrative detail required
rubrics_metrics.description: Addresses shall be indicated in accordance with applicable [standards] and comprise all the relevant administrative units, including the house (and other unit details).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete addresses for authorisors and authorisees including all administrative subdivisions (house number/street/department/unit) so the place of business is unambiguous.

rubrics_metrics.name: Place of business name and address (Rule 41(2)(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: The name(s) and address of the place of business of the authorisee(s) must be given in accordance with Rule 41(2)(c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter the full place-of-business name and address of each authorisee exactly as required by Rule 41(2)(c). For associations acting as authorisees, provide the association's name and number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation of recipient when multiple authorisees
rubrics_metrics.description: If there is more than one authorisee, insert in the address box the name and address of the place of business of the authorisee to whom the EPO is to send a copy of the form bearing the general authorisation number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When multiple authorisees are named, specify which authorisee should receive the EPO copy with the registration/authorisation number to ensure correct dispatch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information on additional authorisors
rubrics_metrics.description: Relevant information regarding the additional authorisors must be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If there are several authorisors, include the necessary details for each (names, addresses, administrative particulars) so the EPO record is complete.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple authorisors: partial cancellation rule
rubrics_metrics.description: If one of several authorisors cancels a general authorisation, it remains valid for the other authorisors under the old registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A cancellation communicated by one authorisor does not automatically invalidate the general authorisation for the remaining authorisors; the registration remains valid for them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Termination by communication to EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: The general authorisation of one or more authorisees terminates as soon as the authorisor or the authorisee concerned has communicated the termination to the EPO in Munich (Directorate 5.2.3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Termination of the authorisation takes effect upon receipt by the EPO of the termination communication; direct communications should be sent to Directorate 5.2.3 in Munich as stated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended use of Form EPO 1004
rubrics_metrics.description: The use of this form is recommended when authorising professional representatives and legal practitioners under Article 134(8) (and employees/associations of representatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer Form EPO 1004 for general authorisations of representatives, practitioners and certain employees/associations to ensure compliance with procedural expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Associations as authorisees: name and number required
rubrics_metrics.description: As regards the authorisation of an association of representatives the name and the number of the association must be given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an association (rather than an individual) is the authorisee, include both its official name and its registration/identification number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to state residence/principal place of business
rubrics_metrics.description: The authorisor must state the state in which their residence or principal place of business is located; this must be given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the country/state of residence or principal place of business of the authorisor as part of the identification details on the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sub-authorisations: types and numbering
rubrics_metrics.description: A sub-authorisation may be specific or a general sub-authorisation; when issuing a general sub-authorisation, Form EPO 1004 can be used and the general sub-authorisation keeps the same authorisation number when it is registered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a general sub-authorisation is created, ensure it references the authorisation number from which the sub-authorisor derives power; on registration the sub-authorisation retains that same number.

rubrics_metrics.name: General sub-authorisation persistence vis-à-vis EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: A general sub-authorisation does not terminate vis-à-vis the EPO upon the termination of the authorisation given to the sub-authorisor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if the underlying authorisation to a sub-authorisor ends, the general sub-authorisation remains effective as far as EPO records are concerned unless explicitly revoked/communicated otherwise.
